items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: I liked Tim very, very much. He was one fine fellow. ... Tim was a very good friend of Peck Kelly's.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, San Antonio is where he's at. And you know who's from over there in Marshall? I guess he was born in Mississippi but moved away like you is Tim Kelly.
Is that where Tim is now? No. Someone was asking me.
No, he's in Jackson. He's retired.

items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: I knew Jeff through his affiliation with Wildlands and the Warriors, and I knew him more so as a player.

ctx.x: And, uh, and one of the Riddicks, of course I knew Jeff through his affiliation with Wildlands and the Warriors, and I knew him more so as a player. Yeah. He's, he's a good, well-routined New Orleans piano player.
Did you know Avery Loposa from Mobile?
